product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™HDMI® KVM Extender 70m | 4K60 | HDMI 2.0b | HDCP 2.2 | Audio Extraction | KVM Pass‑ThroughExtend 4K60 Video, Audio and KVM Control Up to 70m with The Blackbird Pro‑Series HDMI 2.0b, HDCP 2.2 KVM ExtenderEnhance your audiovisual setup with the Blackbird™ by Monoprice™ Series 18Gbps HDMI Extender. Designed for home theater enthusiasts, professional AV installers, and IT professionals, this advanced extender allows you to effortlessly extend HDMI HD signals up to 230ft/70m using a single CAT6/6a cable. Say goodbye to signal degradation and enjoy zero‑delay, uncompressed long‑distance transmission between the transmitter and receiver. Cutting‑Edge Features for Uncompromised PerformanceWith HDMI 2.0b and HDCP 2.2 compliance, this extender ensures seamless compatibility with the latest devices. Experience stunning video resolution up to 4K2K@60Hz RGB/YCBCR 4:4:4, delivering lifelike visuals with vibrant colors and exceptional clarity. The 18Gbps video bandwidth guarantees smooth and uninterrupted playback, while supporting various color spaces, including RGB 4:4:4, YCbCr 4:4:4, YCbCr 4:2:2, and YCbCr 4:2:0.Immersive AudioImmerse yourself in the world of high‑quality audio with support for various audio formats, including LPCM 2.0/2.1/5.1/6.1/7.1, Dolby Digital, Dolby TrueHD, and Dolby Digital Plus(DD+). Enjoy a rich and immersive sound experience that complements the stunning visuals.Comprehensive ConnectivityWith the USB KVM pass‑through function, control your source devices conveniently using a keyboard and mouse. The bi‑directional POC (Power over Cable) function simplifies your setup by eliminating the need for an additional power source. Experience ultimate convenience and flexibility with the compact design, allowing for easy installation in any space.Versatile Applications and Reliable QualityThe Blackbird Series 18Gbps HDMI Extender is perfect for a range of applications, including corporate and business presentations, digital signage and advertising, control rooms and command centers, education and training facilities, hospitality and tourism, museums and exhibitions, and medical imaging and visualization. Its robust construction and metal enclosure ensure durability and reliable performance for long‑term use.Rest assured that you're investing in leading‑edge technology and renowned quality. Monoprice, a trusted name in AV, offers this extender at a competitive price, backed by excellent customer support and a 1‑year warranty. Its robust technology and zero‑delay, uncompressed transmission guarantee exceptional performance over long distances. VIVID VIDEOWith support for video resolution up to 4K2K@60Hz RGB/YCBCR 4:4:4, and compatibility with HDR, HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and HLG formats, this HDMI extender delivers stunning and lifelike video quality. Its 18Gbps video bandwidth and color space options ensure vibrant and accurate color reproduction. FURIOUS SOUNDThis extender supports various audio formats, including LPCM 2.0/2.1/5.1/6.1/7.1, Dolby Digital, Dolby TrueHD, and Dolby Digital Plus(DD+), providing immersive and high‑fidelity audio experiences. Additionally, the 3.5mm analog audio de‑embedding feature allows audio output through the L/R OUT port of the receiver, enhancing versatility. WORKS WELL WITH OTHERSThis HDMI extender is HDCP 2.2 compliant and supports HDMI 2.0b, ensuring seamless compatibility and secure content transmission between various HDMI devices. With features like EDID copy pass‑through, it guarantees smooth integration with other AV components, making it easy to connect and configure your audiovisual setup. COMMAND AND CONTROLWith its USB KVM pass‑through function and support for remote control via keyboard and mouse, this extender offers convenient control over the source device at the display location.
